_meta.name: Interact International Design Tokens
_meta.description: Single source of truth for all Interact ecosystem digital platforms (web, mobile, print). Layered model: primitive -> semantic -> brand -> capability -> state. Generate platform-specific outputs (CSS, theme.json, mobile JSON) FROM this file — never hand-edit the generated outputs directly.
supersedes: Design System Starter theme.json tokens (August 2026, WordPress-only)

technology.name: Interact Technologies
technology._decision: RESOLVED 2026-08-15 (was PLACEHOLDER since Aug 2026 spec). Tech Cyan #128C97 chosen over the original #0E7C86 placeholder: it is the only accent candidate tested that clears the WCAG 3:1 non-text/UI-component contrast threshold on white (4.02:1), ivory (3.66:1), AND pine (3.18:1) simultaneously, so it works as a button/icon/border accent across every core surface without a separate pine-safe variant. Not for use as small body text (falls short of the 4.5:1 text threshold on white/ivory) -- pair with Ink text per the same rule already applied to Gold. Space Grotesk heading font confirmed as-is: real, open-license (Google Fonts), geometric/technical read, satisfies the original D5 criteria.

ai.usage: Wayfinding only (icons, tags, small UI markers). Light surfaces only (white/ivory) -- fails 3:1 UI threshold on pine (1.75:1), so never place on pine backgrounds.
ai._decision: RESOLVED 2026-08-15. Indigo #4A4E9E: AAA on white (7.31:1), AA on ivory (6.65:1), clearly distinct from Gold, Tech Cyan, and Rust. Reads precise/technical without competing with the parent or tech brand accents.

drone.usage: Wayfinding only (icons, tags, small UI markers). Light surfaces only (white/ivory) -- fails 3:1 UI threshold on pine (2.56:1).
drone._decision: RESOLVED 2026-08-15. Rust #B0562E: AA on white (4.98:1) and ivory (4.53:1). Warm, terrain/hardware-adjacent tone, clearly distinct from the other three accents.

success.usage: Fill/icon only, light surfaces, always paired with Ink text -- same rule as Gold. AA on white (5.23:1) and ivory (4.76:1).

warning.usage: Fill/icon only, light surfaces, always paired with Ink text and an icon (never color alone). AA-large on white (3.63:1) and ivory (3.31:1) -- do not use for small text.

error.usage: Fill/icon only, light surfaces, always paired with Ink text. AA on white (5.94:1) and ivory (5.40:1).

info.usage: Fill/icon only, light surfaces, always paired with Ink text. AA on white (6.45:1) and ivory (5.86:1).

state._note: No state color is approved for use on pine backgrounds -- none clear the 3:1 UI threshold there. Use the semantic.surface.inverse + text.inverse pair for any pine-background notification instead, with an icon for meaning.

icons.weight: regular (duotone reserved for a single highlighted icon per view, per existing brand rule)
icons._decision: RESOLVED 2026-08-15 (was never selected). Phosphor: MIT-licensed, ~9,000 icons at consistent stroke weight across 6 weight variants, ships as individual SVGs (self-hostable, matches the brand's self-hosted-fonts privacy/performance stance) and as React/Vue/Flutter/React-Native packages -- meaning the same icon set works natively across the web platform AND a future mobile app without a second icon library. Alternatives considered: Tabler (smaller library, web-only focus) and Feather (smaller library, less consistent multi-weight support).
